verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own getting-started docs show it running an 8-bit quantized GGUF model (phi-2.Q8_0.gguf) and reference ggml/gguf models, so it runs at least 8-bit integer quantization. Nothing in the pack shows the very-low-bit end of the range or makes any memory-footprint claim. missing for 10: evidence of very-low-bit (e.g., 2-4 bit) quantization support, documentation of the range of supported quant levels, memory-footprint reduction claims or measurements, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision

citations.quote: the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support
